title: install-artifact-from-github loads native addons without integrity verification
summary: Downloaded native addons are written and loaded without a cryptographic integrity check. An attacker who can influence the download can execute native code during installation.

severity.rationale: The installer executes downloaded native code in developer and CI environments. Exploitation requires control of the download, rather than merely reading a package name.

exposure: Native-addon installation must use the affected downloader. Download influence can come from a configurable mirror or the distribution path.

params.instructions: Check install-artifact-from-github version and whether the documented exposure conditions apply.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm the deployed component uses the patched release and test the affected workflow with harmless inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
